purpose: Pre-register format-specific selection and confirmation gates before Yahoo-assisted draft observations can append events.

runtimeScopeConfirmation.meaning: The user explicitly confirms that the Yahoo draft has no keepers and no traded picks.

pollingPolicy.coordination: one durable database lease per draft across every viewer and process
pollingPolicy.activeDraftCondition: Yahoo explicitly reports drafting and reconciliation is not held
pollingPolicy.throttlePolicy: honor Retry-After up to the bounded 900-second maximum when supplied, otherwise exponential backoff
pollingPolicy.retryBehavior: never retry invisibly inside one poll
pollingPolicy.qualityClaim: The 15-second active cadence is a cautious product experiment, not a provider-guaranteed publication interval or quota.

selection.rule: Any artifact inspected while changing the parser, reconciler, service, thresholds, or this protocol is selection evidence and can never confirm the resulting version.

frozenInputs: production Yahoo reconciliation and persistence path
format-specific thresholds and expected draft configuration builder
record: holdout league fingerprint selected before reveal
implementationFreeze.failureBehavior: A parser, reconciler, configuration, or threshold change starts a new protocol version and requires a new unrevealed holdout.

confirmation.holdoutRule: Use an authorized completed real-league artifact that did not influence implementation and is first evaluated only after the implementation freeze.
confirmation.independentTruthSource: A final Yahoo Draft Results board or Yahoo export retained and transcribed without using shadow telemetry and before the protected confirmation response is manually captured or revealed to the evaluator.
confirmation.rawArtifactPolicy: Capture one official completed draftresults response verbatim in protected operator storage after the independent manifest is frozen; hash it immediately and never retain it in the production database or repository.
manifestMinimumFields: winning cost per pick for auction

productionReconcilerReplay.implementation: reconcileYahooDraftSnapshot at the frozen production revision
productionReconcilerReplay.configuration: the exact production draft configuration and exact provider identity maps for the candidate league
productionReconcilerReplay.prefixes: every cumulative prefix from zero through the completed board
requirements: each prefix appends exactly its unseen suffix
the completed prefix produces the independently retained final board
no prefix rewrites, deletes, or reorders accepted history

propertyMatrix: snake team counts and roster lengths
auction team counts, roster lengths, budgets, minimum bids, and prices

confirmationGate.rationale: Creating artificial leagues is not required. A protected completed real-league holdout plus independent final-board truth, every-prefix replay, adversarial fixtures, and at least 1,000 property cases can establish mutation safety. Incremental latency remains a quality metric because late or partial cumulative reads leave the ledger unchanged.

snake.observed: The current authorized 2026 snake league is predraft and has no completed draft board.
snake.blocker: No frozen post-selection completed snake holdout has an independently retained Yahoo final-board manifest and a passing every-prefix production-reconciler replay.

auction.observed: No authorized Yahoo auction draft artifact is currently available.
auction.blocker: No frozen post-selection completed auction holdout has exact winning prices, an independently retained Yahoo final-board manifest, and a passing every-prefix production-reconciler replay.
